The Work

Out of this studio

Finished pieces from the shop's own gallery: bright color, a pet portrait in color realism, white laid over black, and the flash sheet the artists draw from.

Services

What the studio does

Tattoos. That is the list, and the gallery above is what it looks like. Tap a card for how each kind of piece starts.

Custom TattoosYour idea, drawn for you+
Bring the idea, the reference, or just the story. Message the shop or your artist directly and the design gets drawn for your placement.
Flash DesignsOff the artists' own sheets+
The artists publish their own flash sheets, and the studio runs flash events through the year. Pick a design and message to claim it before someone else does.
Color WorkIllustrative + realism+
Bright illustrative color, and realism work like the pet portrait in the gallery. If your piece lives or dies on color, start with that conversation.
White on BlackOver blackout work+
Ornamental white ink laid over blacked-out skin, like the sun and moon pieces in the gallery. A specialty of this studio's book.
